Name: African American George
Author: ErenIsTheGamer
Description: This mod changes George's appearance.  It changes his skin color from Caucasian to African American.  It also cleans up his hair and slightly darkens it.  It also adds a small mustache, as well as removing all stains from clothing and his wheelchair.  It also changes his coat color from green to lilac, and his shirt from turquoise to dark grey.  His portraits as well as his avatar have been changed to fit this description.  This is my first mod, so let me know how I did and any suggestions to further updates.  I may release another mod as well that develops George into a deeper character in the game along with this appearance mod.   Thanks for checking it out!

Downloads.Description: Be sure to read the instructions on how to insert the files into your game, which is in the Articles tab!  Enjoy!
